messages:
maria: ISO auditor scheduled for next week — we need an evidence bundle covering RBAC change control, KMS rotation proofs, vuln triage artifacts, and incident response timelines. Who can gather the artifacts?
aj: I can pull RBAC diffs and RoleBinding snapshots. Timeframe?
maria: Last 12 months, emphasize last 90 days for active changes. Need package by EOD Wed.
frank: For KMS I'll export key rotation history from Cloud KMS. Need key IDs and whether EKM/HSM proofs required.
aj: Key IDs: `redwood-inference-prod`, `redwood-inference-staging`, `deploy-encrypt`.
frank: Got it — will export signed history + policy docs. Will need help creating presigned S3 links.
deploy-bot: export job finished — s3://internal-evidence/iso/7168004321/kms_rotation_signed.tar.gz (internal access only).
maria: Auditor also wants sample audit logging queries + raw snippets. @sophia can you pick 3 incidents and run redaction?
sophia: On it. Picking incidents: incident-107 (2025-09-02), vuln-triage-55 (2025-12-10), infra-degrade-3 (2026-02-11). I'll run `scripts/redact-audit.sh` and attach results.
frank: Vuln triage artifacts will include GH issue/PR export + remediation timeline. Command I'll use: `gh archive --org redwood --repo inference --issue 55`.
auditor-bot: Also provide a control mapping table linking each artifact to SOC 2/ISO controls (e.g., CC6.1 / A.9). A sample mapping is fine.
maria: We have a control matrix at `/docs/compliance/control-matrix.xlsx` — I'll attach the latest copy to the bundle.
sophia: Packaging plan: I'll build an `evidence_manifest.json` with metadata lines, generate presigned links that expire in 30d, and upload to `s3://prod-evidence/iso/7168004321/`.
aj: +1. Also include log retention config and Splunk saved searches: `s3://prod-logs/retention-policy.txt` and `splunk://savedsearches/compliance/iso_audit_samples`.
maria: Great. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. Final bundle deadline Tue 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
